status_legend.live_proven: Live route or platform has production proof receipts in the repo.
status_legend.local_proven: Local smoke/proof exists; deploy or live browser proof may still be needed.
status_legend.provider_gated: Core scaffold exists but provider credentials, customer connected accounts, or secrets are required before live claims.
